change.summary: Reviewed item policies define the only system-market outcome and exact quote/cap fields for their selected item IDs.

modifiers.notes: Selector member details are emitted by behavior queries so different per-item values stay in one canonical source set.

rationale.purpose: Expose reviewed BUY_AND_SELL or NONE decisions while unknown and progression-protected items remain fail-closed.
rationale.decision_source: Docs/DEVELOPMENT.md economy ownership and policy contract

introduced.summary: Existing reviewed policies were first linked into Atlas v2; individual original introduction commits remain unresolved.

history.summary: Linked the canonical policy source as one reusable selector and enabled recipe-impact lookup per matched item.

notes: Changing an ingredient policy can affect every recipe and downstream output that consumes it; query_atlas reports direct recipe edges.
unresolved: Alternative runtime acquisition routes and transitive recipe consequences still require human review when static evidence is ambiguous.
